notes: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (cmusphinx/cmudict), ~134k entries, ARPABET. Hand-curated by the CMU Speech Group since 1993, volunteer-expanded, every submission reviewed and approved by maintainer Alex Rudnicky (project README/Credits). BENCHMARK-GRADE per knowledge/wiki/concepts/g2p-benchmark-datasets.md. ARPABET phones are converted to IPA via the standard ARPABET->IPA table (same mapping arena/metrics.py:normalize_ipa's downstream consumers and Grapheme2PhonemePlugin.get_ipa use) before scoring, on both gold and every fighter's ARPA-native output. North American English only. Fetched as a single flat dict file (word<TAB>phones per line), not a HuggingFace dataset — see runner/g2p_bench.py's UrlSource loader.
